4.    M/T:
INSPECT DRIVE BELT TENSION DAMPER
Compress and extend the tension damper rod and check that
there is no abnormal resistance or unusual operation sounds.
If there is any abnormality, replace the tension damper with a
new one.

M/T

P12610    Z16757

NOTICE:
When discarding the tension damper, use the following
procedure.
•    Fully extend the damper rod.
•    Using a drill, make a hole in the cylinder as shown to
release the gas inside.
CAUTION:
The gas coming out is harmless, but be careful of the chips
which may fly up when drilling.
